evals.name: full-bootstrap
evals.prompt: Set up all my office skill dependencies in this environment. I'm in a fresh Cowork sandbox.
evals.expected_output: Detects Linux sandbox, installs pip/npm/apt packages, produces summary table with status markers for each dependency, lists auth-needed tools, notes unavailable tools with workarounds.

evals.name: targeted-slack-jira
evals.prompt: I just need slack and jira set up. Don't bother with anything else.
evals.expected_output: Only installs agent-slack (npm) and jira-cli (binary download), flags both as needing auth, skips all other skills entirely.

evals.name: reactive-csv-analysis
evals.prompt: I tried to run office:csv-analysis but got 'ModuleNotFoundError: No module named pandas'. Fix this.
evals.expected_output: Detects missing pandas dependency, installs pandas + matplotlib + seaborn (full csv-analysis prereqs) via pip with --break-system-packages, confirms csv-analysis is ready.
